name: Hao Zeng
title: Lecturer in Statistics
university: School of Mathematical Sciences, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC)
description: I am a **Lecturer** at the School of Mathematical Sciences, **University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC)**. Before joining UESTC, I was a **Postdoctoral Researcher in Statistics** at the Southern University of Science and Technology (**SUSTech**) and National University of Singapore (**NUS**), Department of Statistics and Data Science, supported by the **SUSTech-NUS Joint Research Program**, supervised by Prof. Bingyi Jing, Prof. Hongxin Wei, and Prof. Wang Zhou. I obtained my **PhD in Statistics** from Gregory and Paula Chow Institute for Studies in Economics, **Xiamen University** in 2024, supervised by Prof. Wei Zhong and Prof. Xingbai Xu. My research focuses on **model free statistical machine learning** theory, methods, and their applications on **predictive inference**. I am also interested in interdisciplinary research at the intersection of machine learning methodologies with **large language model**, **spatial statistics**, **econometrics**, and **biostatistics**.
